name: Drone images and ground control points
summary: Uploading drone image batches and marking ground control points (GCPs) so processing can georeference them.

nfr.statement: Largest drone batch (images and total size) and number of GCPs per upload.
nfr.open_question: How many images and GCPs do typical and largest drone flights produce?

requirements.title: Batch upload of geotagged drone images
requirements.statement: Users can upload drone images as a batch, including geotagged images, and see them listed.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Capture upload (including drone and GCP) (t3d-prd-agent)

acceptance_criteria.given: A user on the drone upload page
acceptance_criteria.when: They upload a batch of drone images
acceptance_criteria.then: The images upload and are listed
The images are stored with their geotags

requirements.title: Ground control points from a CSV or typed in
requirements.statement: Users can add ground control points by uploading a CSV or by entering each point's x, y and z coordinates.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Capture upload (including drone and GCP) (t3d-prd-agent)
Direct code reads during USER migration (2026-10-29)
sources.at: track3d-web src/constants/uploads.ts (GCP input method, values from your CSV)

acceptance_criteria.when: The user uploads a GCP CSV, or types in x, y and z for each point
acceptance_criteria.then: The points are accepted and listed

requirements.title: The best images for each point are picked automatically
requirements.statement: For each ground control point, the system picks the 4 or 5 nearest and best images for marking.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Capture upload (including drone and GCP) (t3d-prd-agent)

acceptance_criteria.then: 4 or 5 nearest images are shown for each point

requirements.title: Mark each point on at least three images, and save
requirements.statement: Users mark each ground control point's location on at least three of its images, and can save their marks.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Capture upload (including drone and GCP) (t3d-prd-agent)

acceptance_criteria.given: The nearest images for a point are shown
acceptance_criteria.when: The user marks the point on three of them and saves
acceptance_criteria.then: The marks are recorded and confirmed

requirements.title: All points must be marked before the upload continues
requirements.statement: The drone upload can't continue until every ground control point is marked.

sources.title: Prior PRD - Capture upload (including drone and GCP) (t3d-prd-agent)

acceptance_criteria.given: Five GCPs, four of them marked
acceptance_criteria.then: They are stopped until the fifth is marked, and then they can continue
